csv_project_name: PM for Hood River Aquatic Center Capital Project
csv_scope_of_work: Hood River Valley Parks and Recreation District (District) is requesting sealed proposals from qualified persons to provide Owner s Representative/Project Management Services to oversee the District s Aquatic Center Capital Project. The selected consultant will support the District during project planning, procurement, design, preconstruction, construction, and closeout, including advising the District on project delivery method and leading the preparation and solicitation of a request for qualifications for architectural and design services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Site Evaluation/Selection, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
